summary: Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) normally needs configuration on both ends. This document describes unsolicited BFD, where one side can start a session and the other creates it automatically, subject to policy. That simplifies "sessionless" applications. It also defines a YANG module to configure and manage the feature.

eli5.summary: Usually two friends must both agree to a check-in game. Here one friend starts it and the other just joins, as long as the house rules say that's fine.
